content.short: Velo provides derivatives market data across exchanges, including Hyperliquid futures.
content.description: Velo is a market data terminal built around derivatives, covering futures and options across venues so that funding, basis and open interest can be compared side by side rather than one exchange at a time. Hyperliquid appears in that coverage, and Hyperliquid's builder documentation lists Velo under perps and order book analytics. It is aimed at traders who work across both centralised and on-chain venues.
